response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_average, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM film_copies ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10
